content: And when the earth shall claim your limbs, then shall you truly dance.
author: Kahlil Gibran
explanation: In The Prophet (On Death), Kahlil Gibran articulates the mystical union between the human heart and cosmic truth. By viewing everyday human relationships, labors, and grief through the lens of spiritual beauty, he invites us to live with radiant vulnerability and reverence.
practicalInsight: Honor this reflection today by bringing poetic tenderness and wholehearted devotion to an ordinary moment of interaction or labor.
reflectionPrompt: How can you view today's greatest challenge not as an obstacle, but as life's tender invitation to deepen your capacity for love?
